supporting_observations.claim: The alerted host made repeated proxy CONNECT attempts to update.chartmate-imaging.net:443 from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC, at roughly five-minute intervals. Some requests succeeded and others returned proxy errors.
The periodic proxy traffic is associated with cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter from the user's AppData\Local\ChartMate directory; process and network records tie PID 3416 to the proxy connections.

The environment inventory provides a plausible explanation—ChartMate's updater checks for updates about every five minutes—but the observed destination is update.chartmate-imaging.net rather than the inventoried update.chartmate-imaging.com, and the observed executable is in AppData rather than the inventoried Program Files path. The evidence therefore does not establish that this is the approved updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations, statuses, byte counts, and durations, but do not expose the HTTPS contents.
The supplied records do not establish the executable's signature, hash, provenance, or whether the .net destination is controlled by the approved ChartMate vendor.
The supplied evidence shows periodic activity from 13:38 to 14:08 UTC; it does not show an equivalent ChartMate connection at 13:30 UTC.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate endpoint or a malicious lookalike.
Whether the AppData cmupdate.exe is a legitimate ChartMate binary or has been altered.
Whether any data was sent or received beyond the connection metadata shown in the proxy records.
Whether the activity before 13:38 UTC in the alerted interval had the same process and destination.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the .net hostname with ChartMate or an authoritative software/vendor record, and compare the observed executable's hash and signature with a trusted release.
Collect endpoint file provenance and installation records for the AppData cmupdate.exe, including any updater parent process or download event.
Obtain proxy TLS metadata or other available network evidence that can validate the remote certificate and characterize the HTTPS exchange.
Review complete endpoint and proxy telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 across 13:20–14:20 UTC to determine whether related activity occurred outside the displayed periodic requests.
unrelated_findings: WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB, and FILE-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON using NTLM. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and merits separate review. (T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00256, T015-00257)
